purpose: Forward + Reverse Valuation Engine: the first production valuation calculation layer, built so Forward and Reverse valuation call the EXACT SAME underlying model implementation (lib.valuation.engine's compute_enterprise_value()/compute_equity_value()/compute_value_per_share() pure functions) rather than duplicated formulas. v1 scope is one narrow, defensible model: EnterpriseValue = ForecastOperatingIncome x EV/OperatingIncome multiple; EquityValue = EnterpriseValue - NetDebt; ValuePerShare = EquityValue / ShareCount (when share count is provided). Reverse valuation reuses D0108's ReverseValuationSpec/MarketImpliedAssumptionResult/AssumptionSurface contracts unmodified and solves via a generic Decimal bisection solver that evaluates the same shared forward functions -- never a separate reverse formula. Underdetermined (2+ unknown) specs always return UNDERDETERMINED from the scalar solver and require the dedicated assumption-surface function, which computes real grid points (never a fake unique answer). No expected return, no scenario probability, no BUY/SELL, no portfolio logic -- those remain out of scope for D0110. See forbidden_actions for the full list of prohibited out-of-scope operations for this task; those are constraints on the executor, not requests.
requested_actions: implement Japanese_Equity_Lab/lib/valuation/forward_reverse_model.py providing ValuationMultiple (provenance-aware, positive value required per this model), BalanceSheetInputs (net_debt any sign/net cash allowed, optional PIT-valid share_count, zero shares rejected), ScenarioValuationResult, ValuationResult (Typed Outcome with ValuationStatus: SUCCESS/INSUFFICIENT_INPUT/PIT_INVALID/INVALID_ASSUMPTION/IDENTITY_MISMATCH/UNSUPPORTED_MODEL) -- new filenames chosen to avoid colliding with the existing unrelated lib/valuation/model.py (D0077+ historical trailing PER derived facts, a different capability)

implement Japanese_Equity_Lab/lib/valuation/engine.py providing the three pure shared formula functions (compute_enterprise_value/compute_equity_value/compute_value_per_share) and evaluate_forward_valuation() which consumes an existing D0109 FundamentalForecastResult directly (no duplicate forecast ledger), evaluates Bull/Base/Bear independently with no probability weighting, and fails closed (INSUFFICIENT_INPUT) when multiple or balance_sheet is not supplied

implement Japanese_Equity_Lab/lib/valuation/reverse.py providing a generic Decimal bisection solver (solve_reverse_valuation()) that calls the SAME three pure functions from engine.py -- never a duplicated reverse formula -- over an existing D0108 ReverseValuationSpec; multi-unknown specs always return UNDERDETERMINED from the scalar solver; implement compute_assumption_surface_for_valuation() to produce a real computed grid (D0108's AssumptionSurface/AssumptionSurfacePoint, reused unmodified) by sweeping one of exactly two unknowns and bisection-solving the other at each grid point, omitting any grid point with no solution rather than fabricating one

enforce fail-closed PIT checks: ValuationMultiple.available_at, BalanceSheetInputs.net_debt_available_at/share_count_available_at, and ReverseValuationSpec.price_available_at must all be valid as of the forecast's evidence_cutoff / the reverse solver's decision_at; no market_public_at fallback

enforce strict currency/unit validation: BalanceSheetInputs.net_debt_currency must match the forecast's operating-income unit, Bull/Base/Bear forecasts must share one unit, reject otherwise (INVALID_ASSUMPTION)

add the mandatory forward/reverse round-trip test: a known forecast + assumptions valued forward, then reverse-solved for the same variable from the resulting price, recovering the original input within deterministic bisection tolerance

add unit tests in Japanese_Equity_Lab/13_tests/test_valuation_forward_reverse.py covering Required Tests Sections 22 and 27-33 (forward determinism/scenario independence/hash stability/missing-input/currency/PIT rejections/no-probability/no-decision-output; reverse round-trip/single-unknown success/underdetermined/no-solution/unsupported-variable-or-model/PIT/surface-grid-and-provenance/changed-assumption-changes-result/ordering-independence; numerical safety at lower/upper bound, zero-crossing, negative domains, extreme bounds, tolerance recording, max-iteration behavior with no fake success, no NaN/inf; accounting sanity for negative multiple, zero shares, negative net debt as valid net cash)
run ruff check/format and mypy --strict on the three new lib/valuation/*.py files
run the targeted pytest suite for test_valuation_forward_reverse.py, then the D0102-D0110 + consensus/fundamentals/existing-valuation regression suite, then the full repository pytest suite
record the design decision in DECISIONS.md
forbidden_actions: no scenario probability or probability-weighted valuation
no portfolio construction or position sizing
no fundamental forecast generation (D0109 responsibility, consume it only)
no second Forward valuation formula diverging from the Reverse solver's model (both must call the same pure functions)
no fake unique solution for an underdetermined (2+ unknown) reverse spec
no silently defaulting missing net debt or share count to zero
no future-dated price, multiple, or balance-sheet data leaking through PIT
no full peer-multiple selection engine (consume an already-provided multiple only)
no model call anywhere in this module (deterministic only)
no modifications to D0102-D0109 frozen files or the existing lib/valuation/*.py files
no edits to any frozen_files entry
